believes: Earth civilization may no longer exist as functioning nations.
There is at least one more Brazilian Empire ship somewhere besides Medeiros.
USE, Chinese, and possibly Australian probes may also exist.

Medeiros arrived earlier than expected and his ship can accelerate at 2.5 G or more.
Medeiros appears to have launched a maximum of four missiles in the engagement.
The Serra do Mar's fabrication systems were less robust because the design prioritized weaponry.

communications.contents_summary: Bob tries to talk Medeiros out of attacking, but Medeiros identifies himself, declares loyalty to the Brazilian Empire, and rejects peace.

combat.notes: Bob uses decoy fusion reactors and six improvised ship-busters; Heaven-1 suffers radiator damage from nearby intercept explosions but survives.

relationships.text: Bob and Medeiros directly confront each other, reject reconciliation, and become explicit enemies in combat.

scenes.summary: Bob reactivates endocrine control, attempts to talk down the early-arriving Brazilian replicant, and fights a damaging but successful battle that destroys Medeiros and the Serra do Mar.

events.text: Bob destroys Major Ernesto Medeiros and the Brazilian Empire ship Serra do Mar in a brief battle at Epsilon Eridani, surviving damage to Heaven-1.

summary.one_line: Bob survives his first space battle by destroying Major Ernesto Medeiros and the Brazilian ship Serra do Mar at Epsilon Eridani.
summary.paragraph: As the Brazilian probe arrives earlier than expected, Bob reluctantly reactivates his endocrine control system so he can function calmly in combat. He opens a radio channel and learns that his pursuer is Major Ernesto Medeiros of the Brazilian Empire ship Serra do Mar, but the exchange only confirms that Medeiros is committed to killing him. Bob's decoys and improvised ship-busters barely work in time: he destroys Medeiros's missiles at close range, takes shrapnel damage to Heaven-1, and then watches his remaining busters tear through the Brazilian ship. After confirming Medeiros's replicant core was destroyed, Bob concludes that more foreign probes may still be out there and that future Bob copies will need to be armed from the start.
events: Bob learns the Brazilian pursuer has altered course slightly and will arrive a couple of months earlier than expected.
He reluctantly turns his endocrine control system back on so he can stay calm enough to fight.
Bob hails the incoming ship and learns that his enemy is Major Ernesto Medeiros of the Brazilian Empire vessel Serra do Mar.
Medeiros rejects Bob's appeal to stop fighting and declares that the earlier Solar System clash marked the start of a war.
Bob flees toward his decoy reactors while Medeiros launches missiles and closes at higher acceleration than expected.
Bob launches his improvised ship-busters, uses them to intercept Medeiros's missiles at the last possible moment, and suffers radiator damage from the nearby explosions.
The remaining ship-busters catch the Serra do Mar and destroy it, killing Medeiros.
After the battle, Bob turns endocrine control back off, confirms the Brazilian replicant core was destroyed, and decides he needs to create armed Bob copies faster than rival nations can expand.
summary.pov_emotional_arc: Bob suppresses fear through artificial calm to survive the battle, then drops the control and feels the delayed emotional shock of having killed and nearly died.

open_threads.text: Bob now knows replicants can go insane during unstructured subjective time, raising the question of whether he can stay sane through training and standby.
Bob is denied access to genealogy records and remains cut off from any living descendants or family connections.
Bob learns that hostile factions inside FAITH could sabotage or terminate the replicant project.
Bob now knows several rival nations are racing to launch interstellar probes, with the Brazilian Empire suspected of sabotage and armed competition.
Bob learns the FAITH facility has a hidden tactical nuclear failsafe that could kill him and everyone nearby if someone decides he is too dangerous.
Minister Jacoby leaves after threatening Dr. Landers, raising the question of whether he will act against the replicant project.
The launch turns into a confused orbital battle with missiles, military ships, and multiple unknown attackers, leaving the identity of the factions involved unresolved.
Bob detects apparent nuclear detonations on Earth after hearing of escalating conflict, leaving the scale of the war and Sol's survival uncertain.
After disabling his endocrine control system, Bob begins fully mourning his lost human life, raising the question of how this emotional release will affect him going forward.
Bob concludes that at least one more Brazilian Empire ship exists and that USE, Chinese, and possibly Australian probes may also be active somewhere in space.

recent_events.text: Bob learns that FAITH has built mission-enforcement safeguards into his own mind.
Dr. Landers frees Bob from his software shackles and Bob survives a chaotic missile attack to launch Heaven-1 toward Epsilon Eridani.
Bob cleans hidden sabotage out of Heaven-1, builds himself a virtual life for the voyage, and learns that Brazil is pursuing him while Earth slides toward nuclear war.
Bob reaches Epsilon Eridani, surveys the system, and starts building a trap for the Brazilian probe he expects to follow him there.
Bob survives his first space battle by destroying Major Ernesto Medeiros and the Brazilian ship Serra do Mar at Epsilon Eridani.
